# DLPack header

`include/dlpack/dlpack.h` is the header from DLPack `v1.1`
(https://github.com/dmlc/dlpack), unmodified (SHA-256
`2540410479f23d62d34c02cb5fce54e4cf165fb315033e9cd948452a65887208`), under the
Apache-2.0 license in `LICENSE`. The Python extension compiles it in for
DLPack export and import. The release SBOM lists it with this version and hash
(`scripts/sbom_bundled_components.py`).
